text: エリカさんを　みてたのか…　あたしじゃ　なかったのね

structure.jp: エリカさんを　みてたのか…
structure.en: oh, you were looking at Erika...

structure.jp: あたしじゃ　なかったのね

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on. Here it is shortened to てる in casual speech and put in the past. みてた = 'were looking'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end shows the speaker has just realised something. みてたのか = 'oh, so you were looking'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives the line an 'so that's how it is' feeling, and ね softens it. なかったのね = 'so it wasn't, then'.
